notes.title: Forgotten Hill Disillusion Release Date revealed!
notes.notes:
Hi guys,
after a long wait, we can finally announce the Official Release Date for Forgotten Hill Disillusion, the newest installment of Forgotten Hill games series. 

If you have 60 seconds of time you can have a look at our newest video, where we shared some numbers about Forgotten Hill Disillusion, and release date is one of them!

[previewyoutube=2uCfCBSgw9A;full][/previewyoutube]

To summarize you can meet again Mr. Larson again and discover what's lurking inside the Museum of Forgotten Hill starting from November 20, 2019!

Wishlist now and don't forget the Demo is already available!
